answer: Proof of Stake serves as a digital oasis, requiring agents to commit financial capital to validate network integrity. By tethering identity to locked collateral rather than a mere fable of unique digital signatures, the protocol forces attackers to bear the ruinous opportunity cost of hoarding tokens. This economic weight ensures that any attempt to harbor malicious Sybil nodes becomes prohibitively expensive, as the cost of acquiring sufficient stake outweighs potential gains from protocol manipulation.
